summary: Reviewed src/server/__tests__/routes/notes.test.ts. 8 tests cover: 200 status, empty-project edge case, multi-project inclusion, full response shape (ProjectId/ProjectName/Workspaces), empty-notes default, non-empty notes value, all-workspaces inclusion, and 500 error masking. Mock helpers and managers are minimal, typed correctly via `Parameters<typeof registerNotesRoutes>`, and consistent with the project's test patterns. comments.note: Test structure is exemplary: `setup()` factory eliminates boilerplate, `makeWorkspaceInfo()` factory keeps test data construction clean. Eight focused, well-named tests each cover a single concern — no omnibus assertions.

The `Parameters<typeof registerNotesRoutes>[1]` / `[2]` cast pattern for mock types is a best practice worth noting positively — it ties mock types to the actual function signature, ensuring TypeScript will catch signature drift automatically.

The 500 test intentionally checks for the generic 'Internal server error.' string rather than the thrown 'storage failure' message, correctly validating the error-masking contract used by all route handlers.
